openQuestions.question: Chromium's full build (desktop project) requests /favicon.ico and logs its 404 as a console error; no icon exists until WP-31. openQuestions.question: The production CSP (connect-src 'self') stops fetch('https://example.com/') inside the renderer before it becomes a request, so it never reaches the cross-origin guard (verified: no request event). guards.spec.ts proves the cross-origin guard with the same fetch under bypassCSP and a local route, and adds a case showing the same fetch under the real CSP trips the CSP guard. Accept this reading of the brief?
